name: How should a homeowner prepare a room before drywall patching begins?

mainEntity.name: How should a homeowner prepare a room before drywall patching begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before drywall technicians arrive, clear a path to the damaged area and remove nearby furniture, wall hangings, and electronics. Drywall cutting, scraping, and sanding generate fine airborne dust. While professional crews put down drop cloths and use containment plastic, moving delicate items out of the room prevents accidental dust accumulation. If the repair stems from a plumbing leak or storm incident, confirm the source of moisture has been completely stopped and the cavity is dry before work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear furniture and decor away from the work area, ensure a clear path for technicians, and verify that any underlying water leaks have been fully resolved and dried.
